label: Ubiquiti UniFi Cloud Key Enterprise
description: Ubiquiti UniFi Cloud Key Enterprise (CK-Enterprise) - 1U rack-mounted UniFi OS console for large deployments: manages 1,000+ UniFi devices and 10,000 simultaneous clients, 16-core Intel Xeon-SP Gold 5218 with 32 GB DDR4 ECC, one 1 GbE RJ45 LAN port, one 10G SFP+ port and a dedicated MGMT port, dual hot-swappable 550 W PSUs, 190 W max consumption.
notes: Ubiquiti's own tech-spec page publishes a port layout row, which is what the 4gon page never did: '**Port Layout - 1 GbE RJ45: 1 (1G/100M/10M); 10G SFP+: 1 (10G/1G); MGMT: 1 (1G/100M/10M)**'. Three sockets total - a controller is not a switch, and the 10G cage is a *single* uplink rather than the start of a fabric. **MGMT is out-of-band** and is kept out of the LAN bridge group, the same call as the OceanCyber iBMC (#739): it is the port you reach the box on when the network it manages is the thing that failed. **The SFP+ ladder is `[1000, 10000]`** because the spec says '10G (10G/1G)' - it will take a 1G optic. 1U, 787 x 43.7 x 481.4 mm, (2) hot-swappable 550 W PSUs with 190 W max draw, 1,000 devices and 10,000 clients. A console/Bluetooth setup radio is not an Ethernet interface and is not modelled.
